findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent callers that observe a nil cache before the first load all proceed to this lock. After the first caller loads and publishes the assets, each waiting caller still reloads and reparses the manifest because it never checks the cache again. A cold-start request burst therefore turns one cache initialization into multiple serialized loads, making every waiter pay the I/O latency. Recheck the cache under the lock and return it for non-Dev environments.
